scope: development-side raw event ordering and waveform metadata only
selection_definition: first 67 charge records that satisfy frozen charge event and have a later valid discharge; capacity values are never accessed

taxonomy_definition.IMMEDIATE_VALID_DISCHARGE: next raw record is a valid discharge
taxonomy_definition.INTERVENING_IMPEDANCE_ONLY_THEN_VALID_DI: only impedance records occur before the first later valid discharge and no later charge intervenes
taxonomy_definition.INTERVENING_CHARGE_BEFORE_DISCHARGE: another charge occurs before the first later valid discharge
taxonomy_definition.INTERVENING_NONCANONICAL_OPERATION: a non-impedance operation occurs without an intervening charge
